instruction: Apply a colored label to all emails in the Bills folder

rules.sql: select (select count(*) from messages where folderID = 13) = (select count(distinct messageID) from messageAttributes where attributeID >= 64 and attributeID <= 68 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 13));

metadata.explanation: Task requires applying a colored label to all emails in the Bills folder (folderID=13). The evaluator checks if ALL emails in folder 13 have a label attribute (attributeID 64-68 represent different colored labels in Thunderbird) set to 1. This is verified via SQL query on the Thunderbird global-messages-db.sqlite database by comparing the total count of emails in folder 13 with the count of emails that have a label assigned.

llm_judge_reasons: SQL query correctly verifies that ALL emails in Bills folder (folderID=13) have colored labels
Left side of equality counts total emails in folder 13
Right side counts distinct emails in folder 13 that have label attributes (attributeID 64-68 with value=1)
Equality check ensures counts match, meaning every email has a label
Postconfig correctly closes Thunderbird before checking to ensure database is written
Use of 'distinct messageID' handles edge cases where emails might have multiple labels
attributeID range 64-68 correctly covers Thunderbird's colored label attributes
